DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 説明の途中で、ご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any questions so far during the explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: メモが追い付かなくなりました。用意する物の名前を、一つずつ区切って教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: メモに追い付くよう説明を区切る依頼をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can no longer keep up with my notes. Could you tell me the names of the things to prepare one at a time, pausing between them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the explanation to be broken up so you can keep up with your notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、こちらの書類です。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前を書けました。次を聞く前に、その書類を家から持って来るのか、ここで受け取るのかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書類名と入手先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have written down its name. Before hearing the next one, I would also like to check whether I bring that document from home or receive it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the document's name and where to obtain it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの用紙は、この窓口でお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We give you this form at this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。名称の横に窓口で受取と書きます。名前だけ残して家で探さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名称に窓口受取を添えて記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will write “collect at the counter” beside its name. That way I will not just leave the name in my notes and look for it at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Record the name together with a note that it is collected at the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次は、案内にある本人の資料です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Next are the personal documents listed in the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 次の名称もお願いします。今度は家で準備と分けてメモします。私が分からない言葉なら途中で止めて尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家庭準備分を分け不明語を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please tell me the next name too. This time I will note it separately under things to prepare at home. If I do not understand a word, I will stop you and ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate items to prepare at home and ask about unfamiliar words. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最後に、メモと一覧を見比べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Finally, let us compare your notes with the list.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。窓口で受け取る物と家で用意する物を分けられました。書く時間をいただいたので、一覧との照合をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録を一覧と照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I have separated the things to collect at the counter from those to prepare at home. Thank you for giving me time to write; please compare my notes with the list.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare your notes with the list. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。順に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will check them in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診でお困りの点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is anything on the medical questionnaire causing you difficulty?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この項目が、はいかいいえか迷います。どちらかに丸を付ける前に、迷う理由を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 問診二択を決める前に迷う理由を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am unsure whether to answer yes or no to this item. Before circling either answer, I would like to explain why I am unsure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss why you are unsure before choosing one of two questionnaire answers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 以前同じことがあったかです。似た感じはありましたが、同じと言ってよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 似た経験を同じと判断できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It asks whether I have experienced the same thing before. I had something similar, but I do not know whether I can call it the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot decide whether a similar experience counts as the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いを担当へ説明して、記入方法をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please explain that difference to the staff member in charge and confirm how to fill it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。答えを空けたのは質問を無視したのではなく、同じか判断できないからです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未記入の意図を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please help me with that. I left the answer blank because I cannot judge whether it was the same, not because I ignored the question.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain why you left the item blank. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 似た感じがあった時期は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you remember when you had that similar feeling?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 去年の冬です。その時の記録はありませんが、覚えている違いは話せます。今回の記録と分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 前の時期と今回を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Last winter. I do not have a record from then, but I can describe the differences I remember. I will explain it separately from the record of this occasion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the earlier occasion from the current one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 未記入の項目を示してお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please indicate the unanswered item and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。去年の似た経験と今回の感じを伝え、どちらを選ぶか案内を聞きます。分からないのにいいえと決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当の案内で記入する方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will describe last year's similar experience and how I feel now, then ask which answer to choose. I will not decide on no when I am unsure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will complete it following the responsible staff member's guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へ確認の希望を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will tell the staff member that you would like clarification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅のロッカーへ自分のかばんを入れましたが、開ける番号が分からなくなりました。荷物が盗まれたと届けるのではなく、管理している所へ連絡する方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 開錠番号を忘れた自分の荷物について盗難届でなく運営者への連絡を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put my own bag in a station locker, but I have forgotten the code to open it. I would like advice on how to contact the operator, rather than report that my belongings were stolen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to contact the operator about your own belongings whose locker code you forgot, rather than file a theft report. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ロッカーの場所や表示は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the locker's location or markings?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 改札の外で、入口から左側の七番です。全体の写真はありますが、運営者の連絡先までは写っていません。番号を思い出すためでなく、場所を示すために撮った写真です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ロッカーの設置場所と七番の表示を写真の範囲と分けて示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is outside the ticket gates, number seven on the left from the entrance. I have a photo of the whole locker area, but it does not show the operator's contact details. I took it to show the location, not to remind myself of the code.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the locker's location and number seven, distinguishing them from what the photograph covers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 連絡先の表示を確認できれば、利用したロッカーの運営者へ状況を伝えられますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you can check the contact information displayed there, you can explain the situation to the operator of the locker you used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。ただ、利用した時の控えもかばんの中です。控えを今見せられるとは言わず、入れた時刻と外から見える番号を先に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 利用控えが中にあり提示できないことと代わりに伝えられる利用情報を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. However, the receipt from using it is also inside my bag. Rather than say I can show it now, I will first tell them when I put the bag in and the number visible from outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the receipt is inside and cannot be shown, and give the usage information you can provide instead. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 中の荷物を、ご自身の言葉で説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you describe the belongings inside in your own words?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 黒いかばんで、赤い上着と帰りの切符が入っています。かばんの中身を話せるだけで開けてもらえると決めず、本人確認に何が必要か運営者へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物の中身を説明し開錠の本人確認条件を運営者へ尋ねる意向を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is a black bag containing a red jacket and my return ticket. I will not assume they will open it just because I can describe its contents; I will ask the operator what identity verification is required.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the contents and explain that you intend to ask the operator what identification is needed to unlock it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が取れるまで、扉をこじ開けたり、別のロッカーを試したりしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Until verification is complete, do not force the door open or try other lockers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。こちらで扉を開けてもらうのではなく、まず表示の連絡先を確認します。運営者へ利用状況と控えが中にあることを説明して、対応や費用を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 扉を操作せず運営者へ利用状況と控えの所在を伝え対応と費用を確認する手順を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Instead of asking you to open the door here, I will first check the displayed contact information. I will explain to the operator how I used it and that the receipt is inside, then ask about the procedure and costs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to leave the door alone, tell the operator the usage details and where the receipt is, and check the procedure and fees. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。運営者へ伝える内容が整理できました。連絡先の表示を確認する際も、荷物と扉には手を加えずにご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. You have organized what to tell the operator. When checking the displayed contact information, please seek assistance without interfering with the belongings or the door.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は何をお送りになりますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 写真立てです。前の面だけを見て包みましたが、後ろの支えがあるか確認してから閉じたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真立ての背面部品を確認して封をしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: A photo frame. I wrapped it after looking only at the front, but I want to check that the support at the back is there before sealing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to check the photo frame's rear component before sealing the package. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 支えは、外せる部品でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the support a removable part?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 別に外したことがあります。枠と一緒に入れたつもりですが、机へ残したかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 取外した部品の所在の不確かさを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have removed it separately before. I thought I put it in with the frame, but I may have left it on my desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are unsure where the removed part is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 梱包前の中身を、ご自身でお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the contents yourself before packing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。台で包みを開きます。支えが見えないから新しい物を買う前に、包みの裏を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 包みの裏を見て不足を判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will open the wrapping on the table. Before buying a new support because I cannot see it, I will look at the back of the package.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the back of the wrapping before deciding something is missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありました。背面へ畳まれていました。無理に引き抜かず、枠と一緒に包み直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 畳まれた支えを見付け包み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I found it. It was folded against the back. I will not pull it out forcibly; I will wrap it again together with the frame.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you found the folded support and will rewrap the item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに同封する物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is there anything else to enclose?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真も一枚入っています。支えが確認できたので、写真と枠を包んで閉じます。中身をそろえてから発送方法を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同封写真も確認し発送準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: There is also one photograph inside. Now that I have checked the support, I will wrap the photograph and frame and seal them. After making sure everything is included, I will ask about shipping methods.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the enclosed photograph too and prepare the shipment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご準備後にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please bring it over once it is ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。明細について、どのようなご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to ask about the statements?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 五月の支出を家計簿へ写した時、二枚の明細にある同じ一件を二度足したかもしれません。この練習用の明細の期間を見比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 期間の重なる二枚から同じ一件を二度家計簿へ写した可能性を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: When copying my May expenses into my household accounts, I may have added the same transaction from two statements twice. I would like to compare the periods on these practice statements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss possibly copying the same transaction twice into your accounts from two statements with overlapping periods. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一枚目と二枚目は、どの期間と書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: What period is written on the first statement and on the second?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一枚目は五月一日から十五日、二枚目は十日から三十一日です。二枚あれば別々の取引だと思いましたが、十日から十五日が重なっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一日から十五日と十日から三十一日の重複期間を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The first is May first to fifteenth, and the second is the tenth to thirty-first. I thought two statements meant separate transactions, but the tenth through fifteenth overlap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the overlap between the first-to-fifteenth and tenth-to-thirty-first periods. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 十二日の三千円は、日付と識別番号がどちらも同じです。二十日にも三千円の別の行があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The three thousand yen on the twelfth has the same date and identification number on both. There is also a different three-thousand-yen entry on the twentieth.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十二日の同じ番号は一件として照合します。二十日の三千円は日付も番号も違うので、金額が同じという理由だけで重複として消しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十二日の同じ番号の一件と二十日の同額別取引を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will match the entry with the same number on the twelfth as one transaction. The three thousand yen on the twentieth has a different date and number, so I will not delete it as a duplicate just because the amount is the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the transaction with the same number on the twelfth from the separate transaction for the same amount on the twentieth. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 訂正したいのは、元の明細ですか、ご自身の家計簿ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you want to correct the original statements or your own household accounts?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家計簿です。私が二度写した所を確認したいので、銀行が二回引いたとまだ主張しません。元の二枚は残し、写した行に照合用の印を付けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家計簿の転記を確認し銀行の二重引落と断定せず元明細を残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: My household accounts. I want to check where I copied something twice, so I am not yet claiming that the bank debited me twice. I will keep both originals and mark the copied entries for matching.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the copying into your accounts, keep the original statements, and avoid concluding that the bank charged twice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合計は、重なった行を確認してから見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please review the total after checking the overlapping entries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。期間と日付、番号を合わせて一件ずつ照合します。家計簿に重複して写した十二日の分を訂正し、二十日の別取引は残してから合計を計算し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 期間日付番号で照合し転記重複だけ訂正して別取引を残し再集計する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will match each transaction by its period, date and number. I will correct the twelfth's entry copied twice into my accounts, keep the separate twentieth transaction, and then recalculate the total.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Match periods, dates and numbers, correct only the duplicated copy, keep the separate transaction and recalculate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。同額だけで判断せず、元の明細と家計簿の対応を確認するご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. You want to check how the original statements correspond to your accounts, without judging by equal amounts alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二種類を別の料理に使いたいです。この混合袋を買って分けるか、別々の袋を選ぶか考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 混合豆と単品を用途別に比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to use two kinds in different dishes. I am deciding whether to buy this mixed bag and separate them, or choose separate bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Compare mixed beans with single-variety bags for different uses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのような料理でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一方はサラダ、もう一方はスープです。混ざった物を買うと必要な方だけ取り出す手間があるので、単品を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二つの料理と分別の手間を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: One is a salad and the other is soup. If I buy a mix, it will take work to pick out just the kind I need, so I would like to see the single-variety bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the two dishes and the effort of separating the beans. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 単品はこちらです。内容量もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The single-variety bags are here. Please check the quantities too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さい袋がありました。二種類を一袋ずつ買い、料理ごとの量を作り方に合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 単品の容量を確認して二種類選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I found small bags. I will buy one bag of each of the two kinds and adjust the amount for each dish according to the recipe.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the single-variety bag sizes and choose two kinds. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 混合袋は購入なさいませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you not be buying the mixed bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今回は戻します。同じ二種類が入っていても、分けて使う予定には単品の方が合います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 混合品を戻し使い方に合う方を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put it back this time. Even if it contains the same two kinds, separate bags suit my plan to use them separately better.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Put back the mixed product and choose what suits your intended use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、別々の種類を一袋ずつです。袋を二つ買ったから一つの料理へ全部入れるのではなく、用途ごとに使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二袋の用途と使用量を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, one bag of each different kind. Buying two bags does not mean I will put all of them into one dish; I will use them for their separate purposes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the uses and amounts for the two bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの商品でお会計へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please take these items to the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Can I help you with anything in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ池を二方向から撮りました。友人へ送る時に別の池だと思われないよう、撮った位置を整理したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ池の二方向写真を区別して伝えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I photographed the same pond from two directions. I want to organize the shooting locations so my friend will not think they are different ponds when I send the photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to distinguish two views of the same pond when sharing them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらから撮りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where did you take them from?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口側と橋の側です。どちらも同じ池ですが、片方には建物が写り、もう片方には木が写ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 撮影位置と写る景色の差を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: From the entrance side and the bridge side. Both show the same pond, but one includes a building and the other includes trees.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the shooting locations and differences in the scenery shown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 地図で位置を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check the locations on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。二つの位置へ番号を付け、写真にも同じ番号をメモします。写真の上下を回して同じ景色に見せることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図位置と写真の番号を対応させる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will number the two locations and note the same numbers on the photos. I will not rotate the photos upside down to make them look like the same view.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Match the numbers on the map locations and photographs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 友人には何を見せたいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: What do you want to show your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一つの池でも見る向きで景色が変わることです。池が二つあるという案内としては送りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 紹介する意図を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: That even one pond looks different depending on the direction you view it from. I will not send them as information suggesting there are two ponds.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make your intention in sharing them clear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 整いました。入口側と橋側の二枚、同じ池、今日撮影と添えて送ります。地図の番号も照らしてから携帯をしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 位置時期と同一の池を確認して送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will send them with a note saying two photos from the entrance and bridge sides, the same pond, photographed today. I will check the map numbers too before putting my phone away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the locations, time and that it is the same pond before sending. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08232-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。園内をお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の杖を一時的に持っています。歩く時に使うので、乗る前に本人へ返せる形にしておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 預かった杖を乗降前に本人へ返す準備を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am holding my friend's walking stick temporarily. They use it to walk, so I want to have it ready to return to them before we board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your preparations to return the walking stick you are holding before boarding or alighting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人は近くにいらっしゃいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 隣に座っています。今は使わないと言いましたが、乗場へ歩く時も不要とは聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在の使用と移動時の使用を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are sitting beside me. They said they do not need it right now, but I have not heard that they do not need it when walking to the boarding area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the difference between use now and use while moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人に使う時を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please ask your friend when they need it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認しました。乗場まで使うそうです。私のかばんへ深くしまわず、ここで手渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の希望を聞き手渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I checked. They say they need it up to the boarding area. I will hand it over here rather than put it deep inside my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the person's preference and hand it over. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 荷物もお二人で持てますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can the two of you carry your luggage as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私は二人分の小さい袋を持てます。友人には杖を使ってもらい、袋を一緒に持つ必要があるとは頼みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 杖と荷物の担当を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can carry the small bags for both of us. I will let my friend use the stick and will not ask them to carry a bag as well as if they had to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate responsibility for the walking stick and bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗る時に支援が必要でしたら係へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you need assistance boarding, please consult a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。杖は本人へ返し、袋は私がまとめました。無理に腕を引くより、歩く速さを聞いて一緒に進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の歩く速さに合わせ支援を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I returned the stick to my friend and gathered the bags myself. Rather than pull their arm forcibly, I will ask their walking pace and proceed together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Match the person's walking pace and ask about assistance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お困りでしたらお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please let us know if you need help.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 用紙でご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any questions about the form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 続柄の欄へ、普段呼んでいる名前を書きかけました。ここは呼び名ではなく、関係を書く欄でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 続柄欄の呼び名と関係の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I started writing the name I usually call the person in the relationship field. Is this a field for the relationship, rather than what I call them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between a name used in conversation and a relationship in the relationship field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どなたとの関係を記入する欄か、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check whose perspective the relationship in this field refers to.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私から見た相手との関係ですね。相手は私の兄ですが、普段は名前で呼ぶので、その名前を書こうとしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 誰から見た関係か確認し兄を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is the other person's relationship to me, correct? He is my older brother, but I usually call him by name, so I was going to write that name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whose perspective applies and explain that he is your older brother. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの欄は、ご本人から見た関係を確認する内容です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: This field asks for the relationship from the applicant's perspective.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。名前の欄とは分けて、兄という関係を記入します。兄から見た私の関係なら弟ですが、向きを逆にしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名前と関係を分け向きを間違えず書く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will write the relationship “older brother,” separately from the name field. From my brother's perspective I am his younger brother, but I will not reverse the direction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate names from relationships and write from the correct perspective. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかにも同じ欄がございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are there any other fields like this?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もう一人分があります。妻の欄も同じように、私から見た関係で確認して書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別の家族も同じ基準で記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is another person's section. I will likewise check and write my wife's relationship from my own perspective.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use the same standard when entering another family member. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記入後に、名前と関係を見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: After filling it in, compare the names and relationships.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。兄の名前と兄、妻の名前と妻が対応しています。普段の呼び方ではなく、欄が求める関係でそろえました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名前と関係の対応を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. My brother's name corresponds to older brother, and my wife's name to wife. I have used the relationships the field asks for, rather than what I usually call them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check that the names and relationships correspond. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。記入内容を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will check the entries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 姉と来ましたが、診察では少しの間、先生と二人で話したいです。付き添いがいることと、ずっと同席してほしいことは違うと伝えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族同伴でも診察の一部を医師と二人で話したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came with my older sister, but during the consultation I would like to speak with the doctor alone for a little while. Could you explain that having someone accompany me is different from wanting them present the whole time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to speak with the doctor alone for part of the consultation even though a family member accompanied you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お姉様は、通訳や移動のためにお付き添いでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is your sister accompanying you to interpret or help you move around?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここまでの道を教えてもらいました。日本語の会話は自分でできます。診察でも必ず姉に代わって答えてもらいたいという希望ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 道案内の付き添いと通訳や代答の必要を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: She showed me the way here. I can converse in Japanese myself. I am not asking for my sister necessarily to answer on my behalf during the consultation too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish being accompanied for directions from needing interpretation or someone to answer for you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ、二人で話す時間をご希望と伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the staff in charge that you would like some time to speak alone with the doctor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。内容をこの受付で大きな声で説明するより、先生へ直接話したいです。今は、その希望があることだけ取り次いでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付では詳細を話さず希望だけ取り次いでほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Rather than explain the details loudly at this reception desk, I would like to tell the doctor directly. For now, please just pass on that I have this request.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask reception to pass on only your request without discussing details there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お姉様には、どのようにお伝えになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: How will you explain this to your sister?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分から、診察の一部は一人で相談したいと伝えます。道を教えてくれたことにはお礼を言い、同席してもらう範囲は別に話し合います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族へ自分から同席範囲の希望とお礼を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will tell her myself that I want to consult alone for part of the examination. I will thank her for showing me the way and discuss separately how much of the consultation she will attend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Personally tell your family member your wishes about their presence and thank them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 実際のご案内は、診察担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check with the consultation staff about the actual arrangements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。姉とは希望を話しました。先生と二人で話せるかは、担当の案内を待ちます。待合室で先に別の場所へ行くよう姉へ指示してしまうことは避けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族との相談を報告し実際の同席案内を担当に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I have discussed my wishes with my sister. I will wait for the staff's guidance on whether I can talk to the doctor alone. I will avoid telling my sister in advance to go somewhere else from the waiting room.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that you have discussed it with your family and confirm the actual attendance arrangements with staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。同席のご希望を担当へ伝えます。こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-08233-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I will tell the staff your wishes about having someone present. Please wait here.
